# IEDC SNMIMT

> Innovation and Entrepreneurship Development Centre at SNM Institute of Management and Technology.

The official public digital presence of IEDC at SNMIMT. This website provides public information about our programmes, events, startups, and community activities.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/): Official homepage and primary contact point.
- [About](https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/about): Information about our vision, mission, and organizational context.
- [Events](https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/events): Public listing of upcoming and past IEDC events and programmes.
- [Announcements](https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/announcements): Official public announcements and updates.
- [Startups](https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/startups): Public profiles and information about startups incubated or associated with IEDC.
- [Gallery](https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/gallery): Public media gallery of events and activities.
- [Team](https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/team): Public roster of the IEDC executive committee, members, and mentors.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/privacy-policy): Website privacy policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/terms): Website terms and conditions.

## Content Sources

- **Events Detail**: Detailed information for specific events is available at https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/events/[slug].
- **Startups Detail**: Detailed profiles for specific startups are available at https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/startups/[slug].
- **Announcements Detail**: Detailed announcements are available at https://iedc-snmimt.vercel.app/announcements/[slug].
